evidenceClass: actual installed CoreAudio HAL routing with independent PCM recorder
procedure: Ephemeral GitHub runner builds and installs the pinned GPL HAL device. Independent C IOProc receiver starts first. Swift AudioCoordinator routes a 440 Hz tone, changes the bus to -12 dB and then mutes. The recorder captures 12 seconds. A separate Python analyzer checks ordered sustained amplitude/frequency/silence and stereo identity. Three muted stop/restart cycles also pass.

capture.format: RIFF stereo IEEE Float32 little endian

limitations: Short run; does not establish long-term stability, latency, drift or scale.
No microphone, per-application tap, permissions, AU chain, hotplug or sleep/wake validation.
Universal bundle built, but this runtime result covers arm64 only.
No app installer, upgrade, notarization, or independent reference fidelity validation.
Compiled driver binary hash was not retained in this first run; source revision and build manifest are retained.
deviceBufferFrames: Not explicitly recorded by the first probe; callback totals are retained.
